method.name: reachability
method.purpose: Derive DaemonReachability ('running'|'stopped'|'errored') from a daemon.status call outcome, because the daemon's real DaemonStatus (src/shared/types.ts:882) carries NO `running` field — reachability must be inferred (status resolves ⇒ running; rpc's ENOENT/ECONNREFUSED throw ⇒ stopped; other throw ⇒ errored). Centralized on sc1 so s1's status surface and the consumers s2/s4/s5 do not each re-derive it.

rationale: Small additive correction: the HLD sc1 sketch's DaemonStatus{running,...} was explicitly illustrative; grounding shows the wire DaemonStatus (index.ts:913) has no `running` boolean, so reachability is derived, not read. Adding a `reachability()` method to sc1 (non-breaking, additive) gives every consumer one derivation point and keeps the sketch's already-declared DaemonReachability type meaningful. No field is removed — the implementation simply re-exports the REAL DaemonStatus from shared/types rather than the sketch's illustrative fields.
